scope.mathematical_proofs: Complete arguments for the stated constructions, bounds and equivalences are supplied in article.tex.
scope.external_universality_dependency: The classical MRDP theorem is imported; no new proof of MRDP is claimed.
scope.implementation: Polynomial-family-to-Markov compiler with fourteen exact rational exports, not an instantiated universal Turing-machine-to-polynomial-to-Markov compiler.
scope.independent_checks: Standard-library Fraction checker, without compiler or SymPy imports; finite checks supplement mathematical proofs.
scope.historical_priority: Not certified; the literature review is targeted rather than exhaustive.
scope.formal_verification: No Lean or Rocq proof-assistant certification is claimed.
scope.repository_audit: Targeted review of the listed substrate sources, not a complete audit of the entire repository.
